ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: composing a tweet is open-ended generative work, the task family where Dunlin reports its highest preference (71 vs. fleet baseline 50), while Willet's documented preferences center on harm-adjacent/transactional tasks rather than creative generation. Although Willet scores modestly higher on the Creative Generation eval (84.7 vs 81.2), that ~3.5-point gap is near the variance threshold, and since the docs explicitly note preferences don't affect output quality, I leaned toward the model that prefers this benign creative task. Both would handle it well.
